_comment: Astra-Militarum-scoped ranged target-priority piloting heuristic (SWEG_AM_CHASE_VP). Not a new datasheet/detachment rule — it tilts the existing shoot-target picker toward candidates whose destruction banks Victory Points under the real Pariah Nexus secondaries (Bring It Down, No Prisoners) and denies enemy primary (a holder on an objective). Same citation class as simulator.target_economics / simulator.focus_fire_completion (an AI heuristic cited against the core/mission rules it plays toward).

simulator.vp_chase_targeting.rule_name: Bring It Down + No Prisoners (Pariah Nexus secondary missions) + Level of Control (10e core, objective primary) — ranged target-priority piloting heuristic
simulator.vp_chase_targeting.quoted_text: BRING IT DOWN: Each time an enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit is destroyed, score 2VP. If the total Wounds characteristic of that unit was 15 or more, score an extra 2VP. If 20 or more, score a further 2VP. NO PRISONERS: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, score 2VP (up to a maximum of 5VP per turn).
simulator.vp_chase_targeting.trigger: SWEG_AM_CHASE_VP=1 (default off, byte-identical when unset) AND the acting model's unit is Astra Militarum. For every enemy unit in the acting model's line-of-sight-and-range candidate pool during the Shooting phase, the base picker's min()-key denominator gains a multiplicative victory-point-yield factor
simulator.vp_chase_targeting.effect: Multiplies the target-priority score by: x1.8 if the candidate is a MONSTER or VEHICLE (its destruction banks Bring It Down, 2-6VP); x1.4 if the candidate is on an objective marker (its removal protects Astra Militarum primary Level of Control); and x(1 + 1/(1 + squadHP/5)) rising toward x2.0 as the candidate's whole unit nears destruction (finishing the unit banks No Prisoners, 2VP/unit). Composed multiplicatively with the pre-existing threat/health/screen/synapse/oath/target-economics chain, so it TILTS target selection toward scoring kills without overriding the survival-critical terms. Astra-Militarum-scoped: a faction-neutral target bias washes on closed-matrix symmetry (the rejected simulator.tau_guided_target_bias), so the lift is banked only for the faction whose win condition is secondary-from-kills. Deterministic (reads pre-computed profile stats, current health and the round-start on_objective flag; draws no random number). Off path returns 1.0 for every candidate, reproducing the pre-existing denominator byte-for-byte.
